# Third-party notices

This inventory is generated from the exact crates.io archives and Git commit
pinned in `Cargo.lock`. Each archive SHA-256 and Git checkout identity is
verified before its declared license is recorded. The corresponding license
texts remain in each source archive or checkout;
redistributors must preserve any package-specific attribution or notice files.

Run `python3 scripts/generate_third_party_notices.py --check` to verify
the tracked inventory without contacting the network.
